events.body:
## Outcome

Browsing, searching, reviewing, and operating repositories feels immediate and legible for keyboard, pointer, touch, and assistive-technology users.

## Scope

- Set budgets for startup, repository browse, search, diff rendering, navigation, and perceived feedback on local and remote data.
- Complete keyboard navigation, command palette, readable diffs, copy-ready commands, empty/error/offline states, and accessible themes.
- Test responsive web, desktop, and mobile journeys with accessibility tooling and representative users.

## Acceptance criteria

- Core interaction and accessibility budgets run in CI and block regressions.
- All primary tasks are keyboard-complete with visible focus, semantic labels, contrast, zoom, and reduced-motion support.
- Usability cohorts complete browse, clone, issue, review, and mirror tasks within target time and error rates.
- Linked automated evidence covers supported platforms, failure paths, rollback/recovery, documentation, and telemetry before closure.

## Delivery and dependencies

- Portfolio tier: **P0 adoption gate**
- Milestone: **Preservation public alpha**
- Numeric priority: **21 of 44** (1 is highest)
- Depends on: #476, #480
- Assignee: unassigned until an accountable owner accepts the epic; fund independently releasable child issues rather than this umbrella epic.

## Progress baseline

**60% as of 2026-07-22.** ForkMesh has substantial native/web/mobile interfaces, repository search and diffs, keyboard-oriented controls, and performance work; unified budgets and accessibility validation remain. Progress may not exceed 85% without end-to-end validation or 95% without security, documentation, telemetry, and rollout evidence.

## Verification and measures

Primary measures: Task time, interaction latency, accessibility violations, user errors, satisfaction, and retention. Closure requires linked test runs, operational evidence, and current user-facing documentation.
